The '''DL-series''' was a model of [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] manfactured by [[Veril Line Systems/Legends|Veril Line Systems]]. One of these [[Droid/Legends|droids]], [[DL-X2]] provided security<ref name="CSWE" /> at the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency's [[Tomorrowland Starport]].<ref name="Star Tours" />
